content:
Despite many new episodes of "Ted Lasso" Season 4 yet to air, according to the latest report by Sigmund Judge, viewers may not have to wait long after the Season 4 finale for Season 5.

Apple is reportedly set to begin filming Season 5 of "Ted Lasso" in January next year.

When "Ted Lasso" Season 3 concluded in 2023, the entire series felt like it had reached its end. Although many viewers (and even the cast) hoped the show could continue, the prospects remained uncertain.

Now that "Ted Lasso" has finally returned, all signs indicate that Apple and Jason Sudeikis are planning to make several more seasons.

A series of posts published today on X by Sigmund Judge brings good news on this matter.

Judge has previously accurately reported exclusive news about "Ted Lasso" and other Apple TV+ related series.

Since filming will begin in a few months, there's a good chance we'll see Season 5 of "Ted Lasso" return on Apple TV+ in 2027.

New Season 4 episodes will continue airing until October 7, so there's still plenty of Lasso content to enjoy during this period. Although Apple has not officially confirmed a renewal, the chances of announcing the start of production on Season 5 as Season 4 wraps up are quite high.

In related news, another Apple series by "Ted Lasso" co-creator Bill Lawrence, "Bad Monkey," will return later this year, while his other popular series "Shrinking" is expected to air its fourth season in early 2027.

Season 5 of "Ted Lasso" starting production so soon—are you excited? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV+ costs US$12.99 per month, and can also be subscribed to through the Apple One bundle.
